about.en: IAUon is the Ondo tokenized ETF for the iShares Gold Trust, BlackRock's physically backed gold ETF, issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited on the Ondo Global Markets platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is fully backed by IAU fund shares and is a total-return tracker: it gives the economic exposure of holding IAU with dividends reinvested, so one token does not necessarily equal one fund share. It is deployed on Ethereum (0x4f0CA3df1c2e6b943cf82E649d576ffe7B2fABCF), BNB Chain, Solana and HyperEVM.
